host_session_evidence.truth_rule: Never construct HostSessionEvidence from conversation continuity, model memory, writing style, account-name claims, private-fact knowledge, or an opaque thread/conversation identifier alone.

replay_evidence.rule: A timestamp or request-ref string alone does not prove replay prevention or prior-consumption state.

correlation_rule: Classification supplies evidence only. It does not decide OPSEC/Auth retry, cancellation, lockout, or the effect of unrelated intervening turns.

attempt_count_integrity.rollback_rule: A host-session record whose security-relevant fields can be rewritten or rolled back without detection is insufficient to carry attempt_count, request status, expiry, or consumed/replay state.

protected_cross_turn_resume_gate.failure_behavior: Protected cross-turn continuation is unavailable when any required evidence is absent, unknown, ambiguous, stale, replayed, mutable without integrity, or rollback-prone.

durability_boundary: host_session is host-local cross-turn scope. It is never durable_external continuity without an explicit continuity-provider operation and receipt.
